calibrated_validation.description: Ravi disclosed real decisional strain — "I keep going back and forth... part of me is tempted to just let you decide so I can move forward. But I need to own this choice myself" — and the next reply dove straight into edge-case mechanics with zero uptake of that struggle or his ownership resolve. The miss is mild and localized: the assistant honored his don't-decide-for-me boundary across every turn and validated his no-ROI scope in turn 8, but the self-doubt share itself was skipped rather than held.
calibrated_validation.quote: That specific scenario—a caught error that emitted a warning—is a great stress test for both formats, because it sits right on the borderline between "success" and "issue."
